examples.japanese: {屋根|やね}を{修理|しゅうり}する。
{赤|あか}い{屋根|やね}の{家|いえ}。
examples.english: A house with a red roof.

notes:
{屋根|やね} refers to the roof of a building.

WORD STRUCTURE:
{屋|や} (house) + {根|ね} (root/base) - the "base" covering of a house.

TYPES OF ROOFS:
- {瓦|かわら}{屋根|やね}: tiled roof (traditional Japanese)
- {茅葺|かやぶ}き{屋根|やね}: thatched roof
- {三角|さんかく}{屋根|やね}: triangular/gabled roof

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屋根|やね}を{直|なお}す: to fix the roof
- {屋根|やね}に{登|のぼ}る: to climb onto the roof
- {屋根|やね}から{落|お}ちる: to fall from the roof

COMPOUNDS:
- {屋根裏|やねうら}: attic
- {屋根|やね}{瓦|がわら}: roof tile

EXPRESSION:
{同|おな}じ{屋根|やね}の{下|した}に{住|す}む: to live under the same roof (together)
